451: 			}

623: 			}
624: 
625: 			LOGD("%s, FMT: YUV422, PPI: %dX%d, use HARDWARE DECODE\r\n",

659: #if CONFIG_JPEG_SW_DECODE_SUPPORT_BY_FRAME

705: 			ret = bk_jpeg_decode_sw_open(jdec_config->jpeg_decode_handle);

725: 		LOGV("%s, [0]:%d, [1]%d\n", __func__, jdec_config->mux_buf[0].state[PIPELINE_MOD_SW_DEC], jdec_config->mux_buf[1].state[PIPELINE_MOD_SW_DEC]);
726: 	}

728: 	if (jdec_config->jdec_mode == JPEGDEC_HW_MODE || jdec_config->jdec_type == JPEGDEC_BY_LINE)

745: 		jdec_config->work_buf = &jdec_config->mux_buf[0];

754: 
755: 	// step 2: start jpeg decode
756: 	if (jdec_config->jdec_mode == JPEGDEC_HW_MODE)

758: 		rtos_lock_mutex(&jdec_info->lock);
759: 
760: 		for (int i = 0; i < PIPELINE_MOD_MAX; i++)

772: 		DECODER_FRAME_START();

777: 		// wait buf state all in idle

783: 		rtos_unlock_mutex(&jdec_info->lock);
784: 
785: 		if (!rtos_is_oneshot_timer_running(&jdec_config->decoder_timer))

787: 			rtos_start_oneshot_timer(&jdec_config->decoder_timer);

790: 		jdec_config->mux_buf_count++;

812: 
813: 	if (ret != BK_OK)

815: 		if (rtos_is_oneshot_timer_running(&jdec_config->decoder_timer))

817: 			rtos_stop_oneshot_timer(&jdec_config->decoder_timer);

819: 		if (jdec_config->work_buf)

821: 			// set work buf to idle
822: 			os_memset(&jdec_config->work_buf->state, 0, sizeof(jdec_config->work_buf->state));

824: 
825: 		if (jdec_config->jpeg_cbs->complete != NULL)
826: 		{
827: 			jdec_config->jpeg_cbs->complete(BK_FAIL, jdec_config->jpeg_frame);

830: 
831: 		jpeg_get_task_send_msg(JPEGDEC_START, 0);

834: 	else
835: 	{
836: 		// only for jpegdec_software_mode
837: 		if (jdec_config->jdec_mode == JPEGDEC_SW_MODE)
838: 		{
839: 			if (jdec_config->jdec_type == JPEGDEC_BY_LINE)

855: static void jpeg_decode_line_done_handle(uint32_t param)
856: {
857: 	pipeline_mux_buf_t *mux_buf = (pipeline_mux_buf_t*)param;
858: 	pipeline_encode_request_t request;
859: 
860: 	if (rtos_is_oneshot_timer_running(&jdec_config->decoder_timer))
861: 	{
862: 		rtos_stop_oneshot_timer(&jdec_config->decoder_timer);
863: 	}
864: 
865: 	if(jdec_config->jpeg_frame == NULL)
866: 	{
867: 		LOGW("%s jdec err cb already executed, jpeg frame is null\n", __func__);
868: 		return;
869: 	}
870: 
871: 	request.jdec_type = jdec_config->jdec_type;
872: 	request.width = jdec_config->jpeg_frame->width;
873: 	request.height = jdec_config->jpeg_frame->height;
874: 	request.sequence = jdec_config->jpeg_frame->sequence;
875: 	request.buffer = &mux_buf->buffer;
876: 
877: 	int j = 0;
878: 	rtos_lock_mutex(&jdec_info->lock);
879: 	for (int i = 0; i < PIPELINE_MOD_LINE_MAX; i++)
880: 	{
881: 		if (mux_buf->state[i] == MUX_BUFFER_PRESET)
882: 		{
883: 			int ret = BK_FAIL;
884: 
885: 			if (jdec_config->cb[i])
886: 			{
887: 				LOGV("%s, %d\n", __func__, i);
888: 				ret = jdec_config->cb[i](&request, mux_callback[i], NULL);
889: 				j++;
890: 			}
891: 
892: 			if (ret != BK_OK)
893: 			{
894: 				mux_buf->state[i] = MUX_BUFFER_IDLE;
895: 			}
896: 			else
897: 			{
898: 				mux_buf->state[i] = MUX_BUFFER_SHAREED;
899: 			}
900: 		}
901: 	}
902: 
903: 	rtos_unlock_mutex(&jdec_info->lock);
904: 	if (j == 0)
905: 	{
906: 		LOGD("%s, %d\n", __func__, __LINE__);
907: 		jpeg_decode_task_send_msg(JPEGDEC_FINISH, 0);
908: 	}
909: 	else
910: 	{
911: 		if (0)//jdec_config->mux_buf_count < MUX_MAX)
912: 		{
913: 			if (!jpeg_decode_frame_is_last_line(mux_buf->buffer.index))
914: 			{
915: 				uint8_t next_id = !(mux_buf->buffer.id);
916: 				pipeline_mux_buf_t *mux_next = &jdec_config->mux_buf[next_id];
917: 				if (jpeg_decode_mux_buf_mask(mux_next))
918: 				{
919: 					jpeg_decode_line_start_continue();
920: 				}
921: 			}
922: 		}
923: 	}
924: }

926: static void jpeg_decode_finish_handle(uint32_t param)
927: {
928: 	// step 1: free current jpeg frame
929: 
930: 	if (jdec_config->jpeg_frame)
931: 	{
932: 		if (jdec_config->jpeg_cbs->complete != NULL)
933: 		{
934: 			jdec_config->jpeg_cbs->complete(BK_OK, jdec_config->jpeg_frame);
935: 		}
936: 		jdec_config->jpeg_frame = NULL;
937: 	}
938: 
939: 	if (param == MUX_DEC_OK)
940: 	{
941: 		media_debug->isr_decoder++;
942: 	}
943: 
944: 	jdec_config->jdec_line_count = 0;
945: 
946: 	os_memset(&jdec_config->mux_buf, 0, sizeof(pipeline_mux_buf_t) * MUX_MAX);
947: 
948: 	uint32_t flag = jdec_pipeline_enter_critical();
949: 	for (int i = 0; i < PIPELINE_MOD_MAX; i++)
950: 	{
951: 		if (jdec_config->module[i].enable == false)
952: 		{
953: 			jdec_config->module[i].start = false;
954: 		}
955: 	}
956: 	jdec_pipeline_exit_critical(flag);
957: 
958: 	// step 2: jpeg decode a new frame
959: 	if(param != MUX_DEC_TIMEOUT)
960: 	{
961: 		jpeg_get_task_send_msg(JPEGDEC_START, 0);
962: 	}
963: 	else
964: 	{
965: 		LOGW("%s jpeg decode timeout\n", __func__);
966: 	}
967: 
968: 	DECODER_LINE_END();
969: 	DECODER_FRAME_END();
970: }

1073: static void jpeg_decode_notify_handle(uint32_t param, pipeline_module_t module)
1074: {
1075: 	complex_buffer_t *decoder_buffer = (complex_buffer_t*)param;
1076: 	pipeline_mux_buf_t *mux_buf = NULL;
1077: 
1078: 	for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
1079: 	{
1080: 		if (jdec_config->mux_buf[i].buffer.data == decoder_buffer->data)
1081: 		{
1082: 			if (jdec_config->mux_buf[i].buffer.index != decoder_buffer->index)
1083: 			{
1084: 				LOGE("%s unknow index: %d\n", __func__, decoder_buffer->index);
1085: 				goto out;
1086: 			}
1087: 
1088: 			mux_buf = &jdec_config->mux_buf[i];
1089: 			break;
1090: 		}
1091: 	}
1092: 
1093: 	if (mux_buf == NULL)
1094: 	{
1095: 		LOGE("%s error: %p, %d\n", __func__, mux_buf, module);
1096: 		goto out;
1097: 	}
1098: 
1099: 	rtos_lock_mutex(&jdec_info->lock);
1100: 
1101: 	mux_buf->state[module] = MUX_BUFFER_IDLE;
1102: 
1103: 	/*
1104: 	 * frame complete
1105: 	*/
1106: 
1107: 	if (jpeg_decode_check_buf_state(mux_buf))
1108: 	{
1109: 		if (mux_buf->encoded)
1110: 		{
1111: 			mux_buf->encoded = false;
1112: 		}
1113: 		else
1114: 		{
1115: 			LOGW("%s multi notify from: %d, index: %d, ignore\n", __func__, module, mux_buf->buffer.index);
1116: 			//BK_ASSERT_EX(0, "%s multi notify from: %d, index: %d, input state: %d, ignore\n",
1117: 			//	__func__, module, mux_buf->buffer.index, decoder_buffer->state);
1118: 			rtos_unlock_mutex(&jdec_info->lock);
1119: 			goto out;
1120: 		}
1121: 
1122: 		if (jpeg_decode_frame_is_last_line(mux_buf->buffer.index))
1123: 		{
1124: 			LOGV("%s %d, %d %d\r\n", __func__, __LINE__, jdec_config->jdec_line_count, mux_buf->buffer.ok);
1125: 			jpeg_decode_task_send_msg(JPEGDEC_FINISH, mux_buf->buffer.ok);
1126: 		}
1127: 		else
1128: 		{
1129: 			if (jdec_config->state == DECODE_STATE_IDLE)
1130: 			{
1131: 				jdec_config->mux_buf_count --;
1132: 
1133: 				uint8_t next_id = !(mux_buf->buffer.id);
1134: 				pipeline_mux_buf_t *mux_next = &jdec_config->mux_buf[next_id];
1135: 
1136: 				if (1)//jdec_config->mux_buf_count < MUX_MAX)
1137: 				{
1138: 					if (jpeg_decode_mux_buf_mask(mux_next))
1139: 					{
1140: 						jpeg_decode_line_start_continue();
1141: 					}
1142: 				}
1143: 				else
1144: 				{
1145: 					LOGE("%s, %d\r\n", __func__, mux_next->buffer.id, mux_next->buffer.index);
1146: 				}
1147: 			}
1148: 		}
1149: 	}
1150: 
1151: 	rtos_unlock_mutex(&jdec_info->lock);
1152: 
1153: out:
1154: 
1155: 	os_free(decoder_buffer);
1156: }

1207: static void jpeg_decode_main(beken_thread_arg_t data)
1208: {
1209: 	int ret = BK_OK;
1210: 	jdec_config->task_state = true;
1211: 
1212: 	rtos_set_semaphore(&jdec_config->jdec_sem);
1213: 
1214: 	while(1)
1215: 	{
1216: 		media_msg_t msg;
1217: 		ret = rtos_pop_from_queue(&jdec_config->jdec_queue, &msg, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
1218: 		if (ret == BK_OK)
1219: 		{
1220: 			switch (msg.event)
1221: 			{
1222: 				case JPEGDEC_START:
1223: 					jpeg_decode_start_handle((frame_buffer_t *)msg.param);
1224: 					break;
1225: 
1226: 				case JPEGDEC_LINE_DONE:
1227: 					jpeg_decode_line_done_handle(msg.param);
1228: 					break;
1229: 
1230: 				case JPEGDEC_FINISH:
1231: 					jpeg_decode_finish_handle(msg.param);
1232: 					break;
1233: 
1234: 				case JPEGDEC_H264_NOTIFY:
1235: 					jpeg_decode_notify_handle(msg.param, PIPELINE_MOD_H264);
1236: 					break;
1237: 
1238: 				case JPEGDEC_H264_CLEAR_NOTIFY:
1239: 					//jdec_decode_clear_h264_buffer_handle();
1240: 					break;
1241: 
1242: 				case JPEGDEC_ROTATE_NOTIFY:
1243: 					jpeg_decode_notify_handle(msg.param, PIPELINE_MOD_ROTATE);
1244: 					break;
1245: 
1246: 				case JPEGDEC_ROTATE_CLEAR_NOTIFY:
1247: 					jdec_decode_clear_rotate_buffer_handle();
1248: 					break;
1249: 
1250: 				case JPEGDEC_SCALE_NOTIFY:
1251: 					jpeg_decode_notify_handle(msg.param, PIPELINE_MOD_SCALE);
1252: 					break;
1253: 
1254: 				case JPEGDEC_RESET:
1255: 					//msg_send_req_to_media_major_mailbox_sync(EVENT_SAVE_FRAME_DATA_IND, APP_MODULE, (uint32_t)jdec_config->jpeg_frame, NULL);
1256: 					if(jdec_config->module[PIPELINE_MOD_H264].enable)
1257: 					{
1258: 						jdec_config->reset_cb[PIPELINE_MOD_H264](h264_reset_request_callback, NULL);
1259: 					}
1260: 					if(jdec_config->module[PIPELINE_MOD_SCALE].enable)
1261: 					{
1262: 						jdec_config->reset_cb[PIPELINE_MOD_SCALE](scale_reset_request_callback, NULL);
1263: 					}
1264: 					if(jdec_config->module[PIPELINE_MOD_ROTATE].enable)
1265: 					{
1266: 						jdec_config->reset_cb[PIPELINE_MOD_ROTATE](rotate_reset_request_callback, NULL);
1267: 					}
1268: 					if (!jdec_config->module[PIPELINE_MOD_ROTATE].enable &&
1269: 						!jdec_config->module[PIPELINE_MOD_SCALE].enable &&
1270: 						!jdec_config->module[PIPELINE_MOD_H264].enable)
1271: 					{
1272: 						jpeg_decode_reset();
1273: 					}
1274: 					break;
1275: 
1276: 				case JPEGDEC_RESET_RESTART:
1277: 					jpeg_decode_reset_restart(msg.param);
1278: 					break;
1279: 
1280: 				case JPEGDEC_STREAM:
1281: 					break;
1282: 
1283: 				case JPEGDEC_STOP:
1284: 				{
1285: 					if (jdec_config->jdec_mode == JPEGDEC_SW_MODE)
1286: 					{
1287: 						LOGD("%s %d status cp1:%d cp2:%d h264:%d\n", __func__, __LINE__,
1288: 							jdec_config->mux_buf[0].state[PIPELINE_MOD_SW_DEC],
1289: 							jdec_config->mux_buf[1].state[PIPELINE_MOD_SW_DEC],
1290: 							jdec_config->mux_buf[0].state[PIPELINE_MOD_H264]);
1291: 
1292: 						if (jdec_config->mux_buf[0].state[PIPELINE_MOD_SW_DEC] ||
1293: 							jdec_config->mux_buf[1].state[PIPELINE_MOD_SW_DEC] ||
1294: 							jdec_config->mux_buf[0].state[PIPELINE_MOD_H264])
1295: 						{
1296: 							break;
1297: 						}
1298: 					}
1299: #if CONFIG_JPEG_SW_DECODE_SUPPORT_BY_FRAME
1300: 					if (jdec_config->sw_dec_init == 1)
1301: 					{
1302: 						bk_jpeg_decode_sw_close(jdec_config->jpeg_decode_handle);
1303: 						bk_jpeg_decode_sw_delete(jdec_config->jpeg_decode_handle);
1304: 						jdec_config->jpeg_decode_handle = NULL;	
1305: 						}
1306: #endif
1307: 					if (rtos_is_oneshot_timer_running(&jdec_config->decoder_timer))
1308: 					{
1309: 						rtos_stop_oneshot_timer(&jdec_config->decoder_timer);
1310: 					}
1311: 
1312: 					if (rtos_is_oneshot_timer_init(&jdec_config->decoder_timer))
1313: 					{
1314: 						rtos_deinit_oneshot_timer(&jdec_config->decoder_timer);
1315: 					}
1316: 
1317: 					while (rtos_pop_from_queue(&jdec_config->jdec_queue, &msg, BEKEN_NO_WAIT) == BK_OK)
1318: 					{
1319: 						LOGD("%s, %d, event:%d\n", __func__, __LINE__, msg.event);
1320: 						if (msg.event == JPEGDEC_START)
1321: 						{
1322: 							if (jdec_config->jpeg_cbs->complete != NULL)
1323: 							{
1324: 								jdec_config->jpeg_cbs->complete(BK_FAIL, (frame_buffer_t *)msg.param);
1325: 							}
1326: 						}
1327: 					}
1328: 				}
1329: 				goto exit;
1330: 
1331: 				default:
1332: 					break;
1333: 			}
1334: 		}
1335: 	}
1336: 
1337: exit:
1338: 	LOGV("%s complete, %d\n", __func__, __LINE__);
1339: 	rtos_set_semaphore(&jdec_config->jdec_sem);
1340: 	LOGD("%s, exit\r\n", __func__);
1341: 	rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
1342: }

58:     dvp_driver_handle_t *handle = (dvp_driver_handle_t *)param;
59:     dvp_event_msg_t msg;

74:         switch (msg.type)
75:         {
76:             case DVP_EVENT_YUV_EOF:
77:             {
78:                 frame_buffer_t *yuv_frame = (frame_buffer_t *)msg.param1;
79:                 uint8_t status = (uint8_t)msg.param2;

83:                 }
84:                 break;

88:             {
89:                 frame_buffer_t *jpeg_frame = (frame_buffer_t *)msg.param1;
90:                 uint8_t status = (uint8_t)msg.param2;
91:                 if (jpeg_frame && handle->callback && handle->callback->complete)

94:                 }
95:                 break;

99:             {
100:                 frame_buffer_t *h264_frame = (frame_buffer_t *)msg.param1;
101:                 uint8_t status = (uint8_t)msg.param2;

250: #ifdef CONFIG_JPEGENC_HW
251:         bk_jpeg_enc_get_fifo_addr(&encode_fifo_addr);
252:         handle->dma_channel = bk_fixed_dma_alloc(DMA_DEV_JPEG, DMA_ID_8);
253: #else
254:         ret = BK_FAIL;
255:         LOGE("jpeg dma config failed\n");
256:         return ret;
257: #endif
258:     }
259: 
260:     LOGV("dvp_dma id:%d \r\n", handle->dma_channel);
261: 
262:     if (handle->dma_channel >= DMA_ID_MAX)
263:     {
264:         LOGE("malloc dma fail \r\n");
265:         ret = BK_FAIL;
266:         return ret;
267:     }
268: 
269:     if (config->img_format & IMAGE_H264)
270:     {
271:         handle->encode_frame = handle->callback->malloc(IMAGE_H264, CONFIG_H264_FRAME_SIZE);
272:         handle->encode_frame->fmt = PIXEL_FMT_H264;
273:     }
274:     else if (config->img_format & IMAGE_MJPEG)
275:     {
276:         handle->encode_frame = handle->callback->malloc(IMAGE_MJPEG, CONFIG_JPEG_FRAME_SIZE);
277:         handle->encode_frame->fmt = PIXEL_FMT_JPEG;
278:     }
279: 
280:     if (handle->encode_frame == NULL)
281:     {
282:         LOGE("malloc frame fail \r\n");
283:         ret = BK_ERR_NO_MEM;
284:         return ret;
285:     }
286: 
287:     handle->encode_frame->width = config->width;
288:     handle->encode_frame->height = config->height;
289: 
290:     dma_config.mode = DMA_WORK_MODE_REPEAT;
291:     dma_config.chan_prio = 0;
292:     dma_config.src.width = DMA_DATA_WIDTH_32BITS;
293:     dma_config.src.start_addr = encode_fifo_addr;
294:     dma_config.dst.dev = DMA_DEV_DTCM;
295:     dma_config.dst.width = DMA_DATA_WIDTH_32BITS;
296:     dma_config.dst.addr_inc_en = DMA_ADDR_INC_ENABLE;
297:     dma_config.dst.addr_loop_en = DMA_ADDR_LOOP_ENABLE;
298: 
299:     if (config->img_format & IMAGE_H264)
300:     {
301:         dma_config.src.dev = DMA_DEV_H264;
302:     }
303:     else if (config->img_format & IMAGE_MJPEG)
304:     {
305:         dma_config.src.dev = DMA_DEV_JPEG;
306:     }
307: 
308:     dma_config.dst.start_addr = (uint32_t)handle->encode_frame->frame;
309:     dma_config.dst.end_addr = (uint32_t)(handle->encode_frame->frame + handle->encode_frame->size);
310:     BK_LOG_ON_ERR(bk_dma_init(handle->dma_channel, &dma_config));
311:     BK_LOG_ON_ERR(bk_dma_set_transfer_len(handle->dma_channel, FRAME_BUFFER_CACHE));
312:     BK_LOG_ON_ERR(bk_dma_register_isr(handle->dma_channel, NULL, dvp_camera_dma_finish_callback));
313:     BK_LOG_ON_ERR(bk_dma_enable_finish_interrupt(handle->dma_channel));
314: #if (CONFIG_SPE)
315:     BK_LOG_ON_ERR(bk_dma_set_src_burst_len(handle->dma_channel, BURST_LEN_SINGLE));
316:     BK_LOG_ON_ERR(bk_dma_set_dest_burst_len(handle->dma_channel, BURST_LEN_INC16));
317:     BK_LOG_ON_ERR(bk_dma_set_dest_sec_attr(handle->dma_channel, DMA_ATTR_SEC));
318:     BK_LOG_ON_ERR(bk_dma_set_src_sec_attr(handle->dma_channel, DMA_ATTR_SEC));
319: #endif
320:     BK_LOG_ON_ERR(bk_dma_start(handle->dma_channel));
321: 
322:     return ret;
323: }

371: static bk_err_t dvp_camera_deinit(dvp_driver_handle_t *handle)
372: {
373:     // step 1: deinit dvp gpio, data cannot transfer
374: #ifndef CONFIG_GPIO_DEFAULT_SET_SUPPORT
375:     dvp_camera_io_deinit(&handle->config->io_config);
376: #endif
377: 
378:     // step 2: deinit i2c
379:     bk_i2c_deinit(handle->config->i2c_config.id);
380: 
381:     // step 3: deinit hardware
382:     if (handle->sensor)
383:     {
384:         bk_yuv_buf_deinit();
385: #ifdef CONFIG_H264
386:         bk_h264_encode_disable();
387:         bk_h264_deinit();
388: #endif
389: #ifdef CONFIG_JPEGENC_HW
390:         bk_jpeg_enc_deinit();
391: #endif
392:         handle->sensor = NULL;
393:     }
394: 
395:     // step 4: deinit dvp mclk
396:     dvp_camera_mclk_disable();
397: 
398:     uint16_t format = handle->config->img_format;
399: 
400:     if (format != IMAGE_YUV)
401:     {
402:         bk_dma_stop(handle->dma_channel);
403:         bk_dma_deinit(handle->dma_channel);
404: 
405:         if (format & IMAGE_H264)
406:         {
407:             bk_dma_free(DMA_DEV_H264, handle->dma_channel);
408:             if (handle->encode_frame)
409:             {
410:                 handle->callback->complete(IMAGE_H264, handle->encode_frame, DVP_FRAME_ERR);
411:                 handle->encode_frame = NULL;
412:             }
413:         }
414: 
415:         if (format & IMAGE_MJPEG)
416:         {
417:             bk_dma_free(DMA_DEV_JPEG, handle->dma_channel);
418:             if (handle->encode_frame)
419:             {
420:                 handle->callback->complete(IMAGE_MJPEG, handle->encode_frame, DVP_FRAME_ERR);
421:                 handle->encode_frame = NULL;
422:             }
423:         }
424: 
425:         if ((format & IMAGE_YUV) && format != IMAGE_YUV)
426:         {
427:             bk_dma_stop(handle->yuv_config.dma_collect_yuv);
428:             bk_dma_deinit(handle->yuv_config.dma_collect_yuv);
429:             bk_dma_free(DMA_DEV_DTCM, handle->yuv_config.dma_collect_yuv);
430:             os_memset(&handle->yuv_config, 0, sizeof(encode_yuv_config_t));
431:         }
432:     }
433: 
434:     // step 0: Stop and cleanup work thread
435:     if (handle->dvp_thread != NULL)
436:     {
437:         LOGD("Stopping DVP work thread...\n");
438:         
439:         // Send an empty message to wake up the thread and let it exit
440:         dvp_event_msg_t exit_msg;
441:         exit_msg.type = DVP_EVENT_EXIT;
442:         exit_msg.param1 = 0;
443:         exit_msg.param2 = 0;
444:         rtos_push_to_queue(&handle->dvp_msg_queue, &exit_msg, BEKEN_NO_WAIT);
445:         
446:         // Use semaphore to wait for thread to fully exit (must wait for semaphore to avoid abnormal access)
447:         bk_err_t sem_ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&handle->thread_sem, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
448:         if (sem_ret == BK_OK)
449:         {
450:             LOGD("DVP work thread exited successfully\n");
451:         }
452:         else
453:         {
454:             // Should not reach here in theory
455:             LOGE("Wait for thread exit failed! ret=%d\n", sem_ret);
456:         }
457:         
458:         handle->dvp_thread = NULL;
459:     }
460:     
461:     // Process remaining messages in queue to avoid buffer leak
462:     if (handle->dvp_msg_queue != NULL)
463:     {
464:         dvp_event_msg_t msg;
465:         int processed_count = 0;
466:         
467:         // Clear all remaining messages in queue and release corresponding buffers
468:         while (rtos_pop_from_queue(&handle->dvp_msg_queue, &msg, BEKEN_NO_WAIT) == BK_OK)
469:         {
470:             if (msg.type == DVP_EVENT_YUV_EOF || msg.type == DVP_EVENT_JPEG_EOF || msg.type == DVP_EVENT_H264_EOF)
471:             {
472:                 frame_buffer_t *frame = (frame_buffer_t *)msg.param1;
473:                 if (frame && handle->callback && handle->callback->complete)
474:                 {
475:                     // Notify upper layer to release buffer with error status
476:                     switch (msg.type)
477:                     {
478:                         case DVP_EVENT_YUV_EOF:
479:                             handle->callback->complete(IMAGE_YUV, frame, DVP_FRAME_ERR);
480:                             break;
481:                         case DVP_EVENT_JPEG_EOF:
482:                             handle->callback->complete(IMAGE_MJPEG, frame, DVP_FRAME_ERR);
483:                             break;
484:                         case DVP_EVENT_H264_EOF:
485:                             handle->callback->complete(IMAGE_H264, frame, DVP_FRAME_ERR);
486:                             break;
487:                         default:
488:                             break;
489:                     }
490:                     processed_count++;
491:                 }
492:             }
493:         }
494:         
495:         if (processed_count > 0)
496:         {
497:             LOGD("Processed %d pending messages in queue during deinit\n", processed_count);
498:         }
499:         
500:         // Cleanup message queue
501:         rtos_deinit_queue(&handle->dvp_msg_queue);
502:         handle->dvp_msg_queue = NULL;
503:     }
504: 
505:     if (handle->yuv_frame)
506:     {
507:         handle->callback->complete(IMAGE_YUV, handle->yuv_frame, DVP_FRAME_ERR);
508:         handle->yuv_frame = NULL;
509:     }
510: 
511:     if (handle->sem)
512:     {
513:         rtos_deinit_semaphore(&handle->sem);
514:         handle->sem = NULL;
515:     }
516: 
517:     if (handle->thread_sem)
518:     {
519:         rtos_deinit_semaphore(&handle->thread_sem);
520:         handle->thread_sem = NULL;
521:     }
522: 
523: #if (MEDIA_DEBUG_TIMER_ENABLE)
524:     if (handle->timer.handle)
525:     {
526:         rtos_stop_timer(&handle->timer);
527:         rtos_deinit_timer(&handle->timer);
528:     }
529: #endif
530: 
531:     handle->dvp_state = MASTER_TURN_OFF;
532:     os_free(handle);
533:     bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_VIDP_JPEG_EN,PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
534:     LOGD("%s complete!\r\n", __func__);
535: 
536:     return BK_OK;
537: }

733: static void dvp_camera_yuv_eof_handler(yuv_buf_unit_t id, void *param)
734: {
735:     frame_buffer_t *new_yuv = NULL;
736:     dvp_driver_handle_t *handle = (dvp_driver_handle_t *)param;
737:     dvp_event_msg_t msg;
738: 
739:     DVP_YUV_EOF_ENTRY();
740: 
741:     if (handle->dvp_state != MASTER_TURN_ON)
742:     {
743:         DVP_YUV_EOF_OUT();
744:         return;
745:     }
746: 
747:     if (handle->error)
748:     {
749:         LOGE("%s, yuv frame error\r\n", __func__);
750:     }
751: 
752:     uint32_t size = handle->config->width * handle->config->height * 2;
753: 
754:     handle->yuv_frame->sequence = handle->frame_id++;
755:     handle->yuv_frame->timestamp = get_current_timestamp();
756: 
757:     new_yuv = handle->callback->malloc(IMAGE_YUV, size);
758:     if (new_yuv)
759:     {
760:         new_yuv->width = handle->yuv_frame->width;
761:         new_yuv->height = handle->yuv_frame->height;
762:         new_yuv->fmt = handle->yuv_frame->fmt;
763:         new_yuv->length = size;
764: 
765:         // Put completion notification task into queue for thread processing
766:         msg.type = DVP_EVENT_YUV_EOF;
767:         msg.param1 = (uint32_t)handle->yuv_frame;
768:         msg.param2 = DVP_FRAME_OK;
769: 
770:         bk_err_t ret = rtos_push_to_queue(&handle->dvp_msg_queue, &msg, BEKEN_NO_WAIT);
771:         if (ret != BK_OK)
772:         {
773:             LOGE("Failed to send YUV EOF event, ret=%d, release frame directly\n", ret);
774:             // If queue is full, release the frame directly
775:             handle->callback->complete(IMAGE_YUV, handle->yuv_frame, DVP_FRAME_ERR);
776:         }
777: 
778:         handle->yuv_frame = new_yuv;
779:     }
780:     else
781:     {
782:         //LOGE("%s malloc frame failed\n", __func__);
783:     }
784: 
785:     bk_yuv_buf_set_em_base_addr((uint32_t)handle->yuv_frame->frame);
786: 
787:     DVP_YUV_EOF_OUT();
788: }

790: static void dvp_camera_jpeg_eof_handler(jpeg_unit_t id, void *param)
791: {
792:     DVP_JPEG_EOF_ENTRY();
793:     dvp_driver_handle_t *handle = (dvp_driver_handle_t *)param;
794:     frame_buffer_t *frame_buffer = NULL;
795: 
796:     uint32_t real_length = 0, recv_length = 0;
797: 
798:     if (handle->dvp_state != MASTER_TURN_ON)
799:     {
800:         DVP_JPEG_EOF_OUT();
801:         return;
802:     }
803: 
804:     bk_dma_flush_src_buffer(handle->dma_channel);
805:     real_length = bk_jpeg_enc_get_frame_size();
806:     recv_length = FRAME_BUFFER_CACHE - bk_dma_get_remain_len(handle->dma_channel);
807:     bk_dma_stop(handle->dma_channel);
808: 
809:     s_dvp_dma_length += recv_length - JPEG_CRC_SIZE;
810:     handle->dma_length = s_dvp_dma_length;
811: 
812:     if (handle->dma_length != real_length)
813:     {
814:         uint32_t left_length = real_length - handle->dma_length;
815:         if (left_length != FRAME_BUFFER_CACHE)
816:         {
817:             DVP_SIZE_ERROR_ENTRY();
818:             LOGW("%s size no match:%d-%d=%d\n", __func__, real_length, handle->dma_length, left_length);
819:             handle->error = true;
820:             DVP_SIZE_ERROR_OUT();
821:         }
822:     }
823: 
824:     handle->dma_length = 0;
825:     s_dvp_dma_length = 0;
826: 
827:     if (handle->error)
828:     {
829:         handle->encode_frame->length = 0;
830:         DVP_JPEG_EOF_OUT();
831:         return;
832:     }
833: 
834:     handle->encode_frame->timestamp = get_current_timestamp();
835: 
836:     for (uint32_t i = real_length; i > real_length - 10; i--)
837:     {
838:         if (handle->encode_frame->frame[i - 1] == 0xD9
839:             && handle->encode_frame->frame[i - 2] == 0xFF)
840:         {
841:             real_length = i;
842:             handle->eof = true;
843:             break;
844:         }
845: 
846:         handle->eof = false;
847:     }
848: 
849:     if (handle->eof)
850:     {
851: #if (MEDIA_DEBUG_TIMER_ENABLE)
852:         handle->latest_kbps += real_length;
853:         handle->curr_length = real_length;
854: #endif
855:         handle->encode_frame->length = real_length;
856:         handle->encode_frame->sequence = handle->frame_id++;
857:         frame_buffer = handle->callback->malloc(IMAGE_MJPEG, CONFIG_JPEG_FRAME_SIZE);
858:         if (frame_buffer == NULL)
859:         {
860:             //LOGE("alloc frame error\n");
861:             //frame_buffer_reset(handle->encode_frame);
862:             handle->encode_frame->length = 0;
863:         }
864:         else
865:         {
866:             dvp_event_msg_t msg;
867:             frame_buffer->width = handle->config->width;
868:             frame_buffer->height = handle->config->height;
869:             frame_buffer->fmt = PIXEL_FMT_JPEG;
870:             frame_buffer->length = real_length;
871: 
872:             // Put completion notification task into queue for thread processing
873:             msg.type = DVP_EVENT_JPEG_EOF;
874:             msg.param1 = (uint32_t)handle->encode_frame;
875:             msg.param2 = DVP_FRAME_OK;
876: 
877:             bk_err_t ret = rtos_push_to_queue(&handle->dvp_msg_queue, &msg, BEKEN_NO_WAIT);
878:             if (ret != BK_OK)
879:             {
880:                 LOGE("Failed to send JPEG EOF event, ret=%d, release frame directly\n", ret);
881:                 // If queue is full, release the frame directly
882:                 handle->callback->complete(IMAGE_MJPEG, handle->encode_frame, DVP_FRAME_ERR);
883:             }
884: 
885:             handle->encode_frame = frame_buffer;
886:         }
887:     }
888:     else
889:     {
890:         handle->encode_frame->length = 0;
891:     }
892: 
893:     handle->eof = false;
894:     if (handle->encode_frame == NULL
895:         || handle->encode_frame->frame == NULL)
896:     {
897:         LOGE("alloc frame error\n");
898:         return;
899:     }
900: 
901:     bk_dma_set_dest_addr(handle->dma_channel, (uint32_t)handle->encode_frame->frame, (uint32_t)(handle->encode_frame->frame + handle->encode_frame->size));
902:     bk_dma_start(handle->dma_channel);
903: 
904:     if (handle->config->img_format & IMAGE_YUV)
905:     {
906:         DVP_YUV_EOF_ENTRY();
907:         encode_yuv_config_t *yuv_config = &handle->yuv_config;
908:         frame_buffer_t *new_yuv = NULL;
909:         uint32_t size = handle->config->width * handle->config->height * 2;
910:         yuv_config->yuv_data_offset = 0;
911:         bk_dma_flush_src_buffer(yuv_config->dma_collect_yuv);
912:         handle->yuv_frame->sequence = handle->frame_id - 1;
913:         handle->yuv_frame->timestamp = get_current_timestamp();
914:         LOGV("%s, ppi:%d-%d, length:%d, fmt:%d, seq:%d, %p\r\n", __func__, handle->yuv_frame->width,
915:             handle->yuv_frame->height, handle->yuv_frame->length,
916:             handle->yuv_frame->fmt, handle->yuv_frame->sequence, handle->yuv_frame);
917:         new_yuv = handle->callback->malloc(IMAGE_YUV, size);
918:         if (new_yuv)
919:         {
920:             dvp_event_msg_t yuv_msg;
921:             new_yuv->width = handle->yuv_frame->width;
922:             new_yuv->height = handle->yuv_frame->height;
923:             new_yuv->fmt = handle->yuv_frame->fmt;
924:             new_yuv->length = size;
925: 
926:             // Put YUV completion notification task into queue for thread processing
927:             yuv_msg.type = DVP_EVENT_YUV_EOF;
928:             yuv_msg.param1 = (uint32_t)handle->yuv_frame;
929:             yuv_msg.param2 = DVP_FRAME_OK;
930: 
931:             bk_err_t ret = rtos_push_to_queue(&handle->dvp_msg_queue, &yuv_msg, BEKEN_NO_WAIT);
932:             if (ret != BK_OK)
933:             {
934:                 LOGE("Failed to send YUV EOF event in JPEG mode, ret=%d, release frame directly\n", ret);
935:                 // If queue is full, release the frame directly
936:                 handle->callback->complete(IMAGE_YUV, handle->yuv_frame, DVP_FRAME_ERR);
937:             }
938: 
939:             handle->yuv_frame = new_yuv;
940:         }
941:         else
942:         {
943:             //LOGE("%s malloc new yuv frame failed\n", __func__);
944:         }
945:         DVP_YUV_EOF_OUT();
946:     }
947: 
948:     DVP_JPEG_EOF_OUT();
949: 
950:     return;
951: }

953: static void dvp_camera_h264_eof_handler(h264_unit_t id, void *param)
954: {
955:     DVP_H264_EOF_ENTRY();
956: 
957:     dvp_driver_handle_t *handle = (dvp_driver_handle_t *)param;
958: 
959:     if (handle->dvp_state != MASTER_TURN_ON)
960:     {
961:         DVP_H264_EOF_OUT();
962:         return;
963:     }
964: 
965:     uint32_t real_length = bk_h264_get_encode_count() * 4;
966:     uint32_t remain_length = 0;
967:     frame_buffer_t *new_frame = NULL;
968: 
969:     handle->sequence++;
970: 
971:     if (handle->sequence > H264_GOP_FRAME_CNT)
972:     {
973:         handle->sequence = 1;
974:     }
975: 
976:     if (handle->sequence == 1)
977:     {
978:         handle->i_frame = 1;
979:     }
980:     else
981:     {
982:         handle->i_frame = 0;
983:     }
984: 
985: #if (CONFIG_H264_GOP_START_IDR_FRAME)
986:     if (handle->sequence == H264_GOP_FRAME_CNT)
987:     {
988:         bk_h264_soft_reset();
989:         handle->sequence = 0;
990:     }
991: #endif
992: 
993:     if (real_length > CONFIG_H264_FRAME_SIZE - 0x20)
994:     {
995:         LOGE("%s size over h264 buffer range, %d\r\n", __func__, real_length);
996:         handle->error = true;
997:     }
998: 
999:     bk_dma_flush_src_buffer(handle->dma_channel);
1000: 
1001:     remain_length = FRAME_BUFFER_CACHE - bk_dma_get_remain_len(handle->dma_channel);
1002: 
1003:     bk_dma_stop(handle->dma_channel);
1004: 
1005:     s_dvp_dma_length += remain_length;
1006:     handle->dma_length = s_dvp_dma_length;
1007: 
1008:     if (handle->dma_length != real_length)
1009:     {
1010:         uint32_t left_length = real_length - handle->dma_length;
1011:         if (left_length != FRAME_BUFFER_CACHE)
1012:         {
1013:             DVP_SIZE_ERROR_ENTRY();
1014:             LOGW("%s size no match:%d-%d=%d\n", __func__, real_length, handle->dma_length, left_length);
1015:             handle->error = true;
1016:             DVP_SIZE_ERROR_OUT();
1017:         }
1018:     }
1019: 
1020:     s_dvp_dma_length = 0;
1021:     handle->dma_length = 0;
1022:     handle->encode_frame->sequence = handle->frame_id++;
1023: 
1024:     if (handle->error || handle->regenerate_idr)
1025:     {
1026:         handle->encode_frame->length = 0;
1027:         handle->sequence = 0;
1028:         if (handle->regenerate_idr)
1029:         {
1030:             bk_h264_soft_reset();
1031:             handle->regenerate_idr = false;
1032:         }
1033:         DVP_H264_EOF_OUT();
1034:         goto out;
1035:     }
1036: 
1037: #if (MEDIA_DEBUG_TIMER_ENABLE)
1038:     handle->latest_kbps += real_length;
1039:     handle->curr_length = real_length;
1040: #endif
1041: 
1042:     handle->encode_frame->length = real_length;
1043:     handle->encode_frame->timestamp = get_current_timestamp();
1044: 
1045:     if (handle->i_frame)
1046:     {
1047:         handle->encode_frame->h264_type |= 1 << H264_NAL_I_FRAME;
1048: #if (CONFIG_H264_GOP_START_IDR_FRAME)
1049:         handle->encode_frame->h264_type |= (1 << H264_NAL_SPS) | (1 << H264_NAL_PPS) | (1 << H264_NAL_IDR_SLICE);
1050: #endif
1051:     }
1052:     else
1053:     {
1054:         handle->encode_frame->h264_type |= 1 << H264_NAL_P_FRAME;
1055:     }
1056: 
1057:     handle->encode_frame->timestamp = get_current_timestamp();
1058: 
1059:     // SEI processing has been moved to work thread to avoid long interrupt callback time
1060: 
1061:     new_frame = handle->callback->malloc(IMAGE_H264, CONFIG_H264_FRAME_SIZE);
1062:     if (new_frame)
1063:     {
1064:         dvp_event_msg_t msg;
1065:         new_frame->width = handle->config->width;
1066:         new_frame->height = handle->config->height;
1067:         new_frame->fmt = PIXEL_FMT_H264;
1068:         new_frame->length = real_length;
1069: 
1070:         // Put completion notification task into queue for thread processing
1071:         msg.type = DVP_EVENT_H264_EOF;
1072:         msg.param1 = (uint32_t)handle->encode_frame;
1073:         msg.param2 = DVP_FRAME_OK;
1074: 
1075:         bk_err_t ret = rtos_push_to_queue(&handle->dvp_msg_queue, &msg, BEKEN_NO_WAIT);
1076:         if (ret != BK_OK)
1077:         {
1078:             LOGE("Failed to send H264 EOF event, ret=%d, release frame directly\n", ret);
1079:             // If queue is full, release the frame directly
1080:             handle->callback->complete(IMAGE_H264, handle->encode_frame, DVP_FRAME_ERR);
1081:         }
1082: 
1083:         handle->encode_frame = new_frame;
1084:     }
1085:     else
1086:     {
1087:         bk_h264_soft_reset();
1088:         handle->encode_frame->length = 0;
1089:         handle->encode_frame->h264_type = 0;
1090:         handle->sequence = 0;
1091:     }
1092: 
1093: out:
1094:     bk_dma_set_dest_addr(handle->dma_channel, (uint32_t)handle->encode_frame->frame, (uint32_t)(handle->encode_frame->frame + handle->encode_frame->size));
1095:     bk_dma_start(handle->dma_channel);
1096: 
1097:     if (handle->config->img_format & IMAGE_YUV)
1098:     {
1099:         DVP_YUV_EOF_ENTRY();
1100:         frame_buffer_t *new_yuv = NULL;
1101:         uint32_t size = handle->config->width * handle->config->height * 2;
1102:         handle->yuv_config.yuv_data_offset = 0;
1103:         bk_dma_flush_src_buffer(handle->yuv_config.dma_collect_yuv);
1104:         handle->yuv_frame->sequence =  handle->frame_id - 1;
1105:         handle->yuv_frame->timestamp = get_current_timestamp();
1106:         LOGV("%s, ppi:%d-%d, length:%d, fmt:%d, seq:%d, %p\r\n", __func__, handle->yuv_frame->width,
1107:             handle->yuv_frame->height, handle->yuv_frame->length,
1108:             handle->yuv_frame->fmt, handle->yuv_frame->sequence, handle->yuv_frame);
1109:         if (handle->error == false)
1110:         {
1111:             new_yuv = handle->callback->malloc(IMAGE_YUV, size);
1112:             if (new_yuv)
1113:             {
1114:                 dvp_event_msg_t yuv_msg;
1115:                 new_yuv->width = handle->yuv_frame->width;
1116:                 new_yuv->height = handle->yuv_frame->height;
1117:                 new_yuv->fmt = handle->yuv_frame->fmt;
1118:                 new_yuv->length = size;
1119: 
1120:                 // Put YUV completion notification task into queue for thread processing
1121:                 yuv_msg.type = DVP_EVENT_YUV_EOF;
1122:                 yuv_msg.param1 = (uint32_t)handle->yuv_frame;
1123:                 yuv_msg.param2 = DVP_FRAME_OK;
1124:                 
1125:                 bk_err_t ret = rtos_push_to_queue(&handle->dvp_msg_queue, &yuv_msg, BEKEN_NO_WAIT);
1126:                 if (ret != BK_OK)
1127:                 {
1128:                     LOGE("Failed to send YUV EOF event in H264 mode, ret=%d, release frame directly\n", ret);
1129:                     // If queue is full, release the frame directly
1130:                     handle->callback->complete(IMAGE_YUV, handle->yuv_frame, DVP_FRAME_ERR);
1131:                 }
1132: 
1133:                 handle->yuv_frame = new_yuv;
1134:             }
1135:             else
1136:             {
1137:                 //LOGE("%s malloc new yuv frame failed\n", __func__);
1138:             }
1139:         }
1140:         DVP_YUV_EOF_OUT();
1141:     }
1142: 
1143:     DVP_H264_EOF_OUT();
1144: 
1145:     return;
1146: }

193: static void lcd_display_task_entry(beken_thread_arg_t context)
194: {
195:     private_display_mcu_context_t *lcd_disp_config = (private_display_mcu_context_t *)context;
196:     lcd_disp_config->disp_task_running = true;
197:     rtos_set_semaphore(&lcd_disp_config->disp_task_sem);
198: 
199:     while (lcd_disp_config->disp_task_running)
200:     {
201:         display_msg_t msg;
202:         int ret = rtos_pop_from_queue(&lcd_disp_config->queue, &msg, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
203:         if (ret == BK_OK)
204:         {
205:             switch (msg.event)
206:             {
207:                 case DISPLAY_FRAME_REQUEST:
208:                     lcd_display_frame(lcd_disp_config, (frame_buffer_t *)msg.param, (flush_complete_t)msg.param2);
209:                     break;
210:                 case DISPLAY_FRAME_FREE:
211:                 {
212:                     frame_buffer_t *frame = (frame_buffer_t *)msg.param;
213:                     if (msg.param2 != 0)
214:                     {
215:                         ((flush_complete_t)msg.param2)(frame);
216:                     }
217:                 }
218:                     break;
219: 
220:                 case DISPLAY_FRAME_EXIT:
221:                 {
222:                     rtos_lock_mutex(&lcd_disp_config->lock);
223:                     lcd_disp_config->disp_task_running = false;
224:                     rtos_unlock_mutex(&lcd_disp_config->lock);
225:                     do
226:                     {
227:                         ret = rtos_pop_from_queue(&lcd_disp_config->queue, &msg, BEKEN_NO_WAIT);
228: 
229:                         if (ret == BK_OK)
230:                         {
231:                             if (msg.event == DISPLAY_FRAME_REQUEST || msg.event == DISPLAY_FRAME_FREE)
232:                             {
233:                                 if (msg.param2 != 0)
234:                                 {
235:                                     ((flush_complete_t)msg.param2)((frame_buffer_t *)msg.param);
236:                                 }
237:                             }
238:                         }
239:                     }
240:                     while (ret == BK_OK);
241:                 }
242:                 goto exit;
243:             }
244:         }
245:     }
246: 
247: exit:
248: 
249:     lcd_disp_config->disp_task = NULL;
250:     rtos_set_semaphore(&lcd_disp_config->disp_task_sem);
251:     rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
252: }

# 多媒体管线跨核数据传递研究报告 (bk_avdk_smp)

## 关键架构前提

本工程基于 BK7258，存在 **两个独立的概念**，必须区分清楚：

1. **AP (CPU1) — SMP 双核**：AP 固件运行在 CPU1 上，CPU1 是 FreeRTOS SMP 双核（core0 + core1）。`bk_avdk_smp` 的 `ap/` 目录和 `projects/*/ap/` 都是这个 SMP 镜像。多媒体管线 (DVP/JPEG解码/显示) 全部在 AP SMP 内运行。
2. **CP (CPU2) — 独立核**：`projects/*/cp/` 是运行在 CPU2 上的独立固件（门铃/BLE 服务）。CPU1↔CPU2 之间通过 **CIFD mailbox** 传递控制消息（如 BLE 数据），但**不传帧缓冲**。

证据：
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/dvp_example/cp/cp_main.c:13-14` 注释 `// start smp(cpu1, cpu2)` 并 `bk_pm_module_vote_boot_cp1_ctrl(PM_BOOT_CP1_MODULE_NAME_APP, ...)` —— 这里 "cp1" 指启动 CPU1 的 SMP app，而 cp_main.c 本身跑在 CPU2。
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/mcu_lcd_example/cp/customer_msg/customer_msg.c:15-36` 使用 `cif_send_customer_event` (CIFD = CPU Inter-Firmware Data) 在 CPU2↔CPU1 间传 **事件**，载荷上限 `MAX_CIFD_CUST_SIZE`，只用于 BLE/doorbell 控制消息。

所以"跨核"帧传递主要指 **CPU1 SMP 内 core0↔core1 之间**，而非 CPU1↔CPU2。

## 1) 帧缓冲 / 帧对象的数据结构

### 1.1 核心帧结构 `frame_buffer_t`

    uint32_t flag;        // 缓冲标志 (FB_ALLOCATED_PATTERN=0x8338 / FB_FREE_PATTERN=0xF00F)

    uint32_t size;        // 缓冲总容量
    uint8_t frame_crc;    // 帧头 CRC8 (校验前6字节)

## 2) Pipeline 节点如何跨核传递帧

**核心结论：跨核（core0↔core1）帧传递 = FreeRTOS 队列传 `frame_buffer_t*` 指针 + 共享 PSRAM 存实际数据 + 队列本身的互斥量/.spinlock 保护控制结构。** 不使用 mailbox（mailbox 仅 CPU1↔CPU2 控制消息）、不使用单独的共享环形。

### 2.1 多核 SW JPEG 解码（最典型的跨核帧分发）
**控制器结构**: `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_jpeg_decoder/include/bk_jpeg_decode_ctlr.h:78-95`
```c
typedef struct {
    ...
    software_decode_info_t sw_dec_info[MAX_DECODE_CORE]; // [0]=cp1/core0 [1]=cp2/core1
    beken_queue_t input_queue;     // 入帧队列 (uint32_t frame_ptr)
    beken_queue_t output_queue;    // 出帧队列 (按 sequence 排序)
    beken_queue_t message_queue;   // 调度事件队列
    beken_semaphore_t sem;
    beken_mutex_t lock;
    beken_thread_t thread;
    uint32_t cp1_busy, cp2_busy;
} private_jpeg_decode_sw_multi_core_ctlr_t;
```

**跨核分发流程** (`/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_jpeg_decoder/src/sw/sw_jpeg_decode_dual_core.c`):
1. **入帧**: `software_decode_task_dual_core_send_frame` line 550-564 → `rtos_push_to_queue(&controller->input_queue, &in_frame, ...)` —— 把 `frame_buffer_t*` 当 `uint32_t` 入队。
2. **调度线程** `software_decode_dual_core_main` line 431-516 (AP 侧线程) 收到 `SOFTWARE_DECODE_EVENT_DECODE_START` → 调 `software_decode_dual_core_decode` line 180-345：
   - 优先把帧分给 cp2 (line 187-248)：`controller->cp2_busy=1`，`sw_dec_info[1].in_frame=in_frame; out_frame=sw_jpeg_decode_out_malloc(...)`，然后 **`software_decode_task_send_msg_cp2(SOFTWARE_DECODE_START, (uint32_t)&controller->sw_dec_info[1])`** (line 242) —— 把 `software_decode_info_t*` 投递到 **cp2 专属队列**。
   - cp2 忙则分给 cp1 (line 249-311)，同样投递到 **cp1 专属队列**。
3. **cp1/cp2 工作线程**各自绑核运行（见第4节），从自己队列取出 `software_decode_info_t*`，对 `in_frame->frame` (PSRAM 共享) 执行 `bk_jpeg_dec_sw_start_by_handle(...)` (`sw_jpeg_decode_cp1.c:161`)，完成后回调 `sw_dec_info->complete(...)` (line 266) → 回到 dual_core 的 `cp1_decode_complete`/`cp2_decode_complete` (`sw_jpeg_decode_dual_core.c:112-178`)。
4. **完成回调**往 `message_queue` 发 `SOFTWARE_DECODE_EVENT_DECODE_COMPLETE` + core_id (line 130, 168)，调度线程据此调 `software_decode_dual_core_complete` line 363-429：
   - 比较 `out_frame->sequence` 维持**全局顺序**：若先完成的帧序号大于另一核在途帧，先压入 `output_queue` (line 372, 403)；否则直接 `sw_jpeg_decode_out_complete` 上抛。
   - `software_decode_dual_core_output_all_frame` line 347-361 顺序排空 `output_queue`。

**关键点**: 帧数据本体始终在 PSRAM 共享堆上，跨核只传指针；指针经 FreeRTOS 队列（队列自身是 SMP 安全的）传递；顺序由 `sequence` 字段 + `output_queue` 重排保证。cp1/cp2 队列**物理隔离**，无锁竞争。

## 3) 采集核与显示核如何同步

**重要结论：本工程的"采集"与"显示"并不绑在不同核上**。DVP 采集、JPEG 解码、显示全部在 AP (CPU1 SMP) 上，线程用 `rtos_create_thread`（不绑核，FreeRTOS SMP 调度器自由迁移）。**真正绑核的只有 SW JPEG 解码的 cp1/cp2 两个线程**（见第4节）。

同步机制层次：

### 3.1 帧级同步 —— 信号量
- DVP ISR → `dvp_work_thread`：通过 `dvp_msg_queue` 队列 (生产者=ISR，消费者=线程)。
- DVP 关闭：`bk_dvp_close` → `rtos_get_semaphore(&dvp_handle->sem, 500)` (`bk_dvp.c:1716`)，在 `dvp_camera_vsync_negedge_handler` (line 704-707) 中 `rtos_set_semaphore` 同步关闭。
- 显示帧完成：`lcd_driver_display_mcu_isr` (ISR) `rtos_set_semaphore(&disp_sem)` (line 121) ↔ `lcd_display_frame` `rtos_get_semaphore(&disp_sem, BEKEN_NEVER_TIMEOUT)` (line 181) —— 严格的"提交一帧→等ISR→提交下一帧"节奏，天然限速到 LCD 刷新率。
- 线程退出：`thread_sem` (`bk_dvp.c:1575, 130-133, 447`)、`disp_task_sem` (`bk_display_mcu_ctlr.c:197, 250, 333`) 用于线程生命周期同步。

### 3.2 流水线节点间同步 —— 队列 + 互斥量
- 每个 pipeline 模块 (jdec/h264/rotate/scale/jpeg_get) 都有自己的 `beken_queue_t` + `beken_semaphore_t` + `beken_mutex_t`：
  - jdec: `jpeg_decode_pipeline.c:131-133` (`jdec_sem`, `jdec_queue`, `jdec_info->lock`)
  - jpeg_get: `jpeg_get_pipeline.c:42-45` (`jdec_sem`, `jdec_queue`, `jdec_lock`)
  - h264: `h264_encode_pipeline.c:104-105` (`h264_sem`, `h264_queue`)
  - rotate: `yuv_rotate_pipeline.c:101-102` (`rot_sem`, `rotate_queue`)
  - scale: `lcd_scale_pipeline.c:130-132` (`scale_sem`, `scale_queue`)
- 节点间通过 `*_task_send_msg` 互投 `media_msg_t`，`param` 携带 `frame_buffer_t*` 或 `pipeline_mux_buf_t*`。
- 模块启动顺序通过 `rtos_get_semaphore(&*_sem, BEKEN_NEVER_TIMEOUT)` 在 open 时等待工作线程就绪 (`jpeg_decode_pipeline.c:1531`, `jpeg_get_pipeline.c:352`, `bk_display_mcu_ctlr.c:333` 等)。

### 3.3 多核 SW 解码内的顺序同步
- `cp1_busy` / `cp2_busy` 标志 (`bk_jpeg_decode_ctlr.h:93-94`) 防止同一核重入。
- `output_queue` + `sequence` 比较保证双核乱序完成后上抛顺序 (`sw_jpeg_decode_dual_core.c:363-429`)。
- 回调链：cp 线程完成 → `cp1_decode_complete`/`cp2_decode_complete` (line 112/150) → `software_decode_task_dual_core_send_msg(SOFTWARE_DECODE_EVENT_DECODE_COMPLETE, ...)` → 主调度线程处理。

### 3.4 PSRAM cache 一致性
- SW 解码前后调 `FLUSH_ALL_DCACHE()` (`sw_jpeg_decode_cp1.c:41, 160`) —— `flush_all_dcache()`，确保 PSRAM 数据在两核间可见。
- 旋转/scale/h264 用 `bk_psram_enable_write_through` / `bk_psram_disable_write_through` (`yuv_rotate_pipeline.c:459, 220`, `lcd_scale_pipeline.c:374, 304`, `h264_encode_pipeline.c:703, 682`) 启用 PSRAM write-through 通道，让 DMA2D/HW scaler/H264 编码器与 CPU 看到一致数据。

### 3.5 spinlock 临界区 (CONFIG_FREERTOS_SMP)
跨核共享数据用 `SPIN_LOCK_INIT` + `spin_lock/spin_unlock` + `rtos_disable_int/rtos_enable_int` 组合保护：
- `jpeg_decode_pipeline.c:167` `jdec_pipeline_spin_lock` (line 170-188)
- `jpeg_decode_list.c:35` `jdec_list_spin_lock` (line 38-56)
- `lcd_scale_pipeline.c:158` `scale_pipeline_spin_lock` (line 161-178)
- `bk_display_mcu_ctlr.c:35` `display_spin_lock` (line 38-56)
- `frame_buffer.c:22-23` 包含 `spinlock.h` 但分配器实际用 `GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE`（见 1.3）

### 3.6 CPU1↔CPU2 (CP) 同步
**仅控制消息，无帧同步**：
- `cif_send_customer_event` / `cif_register_customer_msg_handler` (`customer_msg.c:34, 97`) —— CIFD mailbox 协议，载荷 `MAX_CIFD_CUST_SIZE`，用于 BLE 数据、doorbell 事件 (`doorbell_core.c:302 cifd_send_cust_event`)。
- CP 侧 `doorbell_send_msg` → `db_info->queue` (`doorbell_core.c:263-281`) 是 CP 内部队列，不跨核。

## 5) 是否使用 frame_buffer.c 的共享环形

**否，`frame_buffer.c` 不是环形队列，而是 PSRAM 堆分配器封装。**

**文件**: `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/multimedia/comm/frame_buffer.c` (全文 130 行，见 1.2)

## 总结

1. **帧对象**：统一 `frame_buffer_t` (`media_types.h:315`)，帧头带 CRC8 防双释放，帧数据指针 `frame` 指向 PSRAM 共享堆。
2. **跨核传递**：核心是 **FreeRTOS 队列传 `frame_buffer_t*` 指针 + PSRAM 共享物理内存**。无 mailbox 传帧、无独立共享环形。多核 SW JPEG 解码用 `input_queue`/`output_queue`/cp1/cp2 专属队列四队列架构，按 `sequence` 重排保序。
3. **同步**：信号量（帧完成/线程生命周期）+ 互斥量（队列发送）+ spinlock+关中断（SMP 临界区）+ PSRAM write-through/DCache flush（cache 一致性）。采集与显示同在 AP SMP 上，靠 LCD ISR 信号量限速；CPU1↔CPU2 仅 CIFD mailbox 传控制消息。
4. **绑核**：仅 SW JPEG 解码的 cp1/cp2 线程用 `rtos_core0_create_thread`/`rtos_core1_create_thread` + `xTaskCreateStaticPinnedToCore(core 0/1)` 绑核，栈/工作区放 `.dtcm_cpu1`；其余线程均 `rtos_create_thread` 不绑核。
5. **frame_buffer.c 共享环形**：否。`frame_buffer.c` 是 PSRAM 堆分配器封装（`frame_buffer_display_malloc`/`frame_buffer_encode_malloc`），底层 `psram_mem_slab.c` 是空闲链表首次适配分配器，用 `GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE` 保护。真正的队列流转分散在各 pipeline 模块独立的 `beken_queue_t` 中。
